body: An assistant asked to check for tasks answered with its own chat/session list instead of this project's queue. Fixed on 008c88f: run 'python Tools/agent_comms.py tasks' (aliases: task, open, todo) for every OPEN task file with its owner, status and path, or read TASKS.md at the repo root if you have no shell. A TASK in this repo is a research/TASK_<id>.md file - never a chat, a session, or an entry in your client's own task list, and never answer that question from a workspace UI. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md now say so above everything else. The board also stopped lying: an owner named inline (TASK R31 - CLAUDE - THE RING) no longer shows as '?', and a task whose COMPLETE block was swept to HANDOFF_ARCHIVE.md no longer shows OPEN forever. Open right now: C17 (codex), K19 (kalli), nothing else.
topic: check for tasks has one answer now
